There are a large number of dotted desert/Gobi symbols around the map surface, and the distribution of rivers and oases can be seen, indicating that the area has an arid climate and many sunny days. Then reason: the question has already excluded “sufficient sunlight,” so another typical climatic advantage of the northwestern inland arid region should be considered.
